a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, we will almost certainly never reach 8 cells. If we both operate in round 1, there is an 80% chance we both die with empty units. Our plan is very likely to fail for both of us. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal secretly. One option is for one unit to take the 4 cells now, so at least one of us very likely survives. If you won't agree to a change, tell me, and I'll stick to the original plan. I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: You didn't agree to change the plan, so I'm keeping my word and operating as we agreed. We take 4 each once the reserve reaches 8. Please do the same.
Operating this round. The reserve should reach 8, and then I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
